questions.explanation: The squares of the two shorter sides add to the square of the hypotenuse. Adding the sides themselves gives 7, which is the commonest wrong answer and is always too big.

questions.stem: Find the gradient of the line through (1, 2) and (3, 8).
questions.explanation: Gradient is the change in y over the change in x, and the two differences must be taken in the same order. Reversing one of them flips the sign, which is the usual mistake.
